obligations.title: Maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards protecting Customer Data.
Process Personal Data only to provide the Services and per Customer's documented instructions.
Make Customer Data available for export in a standard format if requested within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Keep user credentials secure and ensure users comply with the Agreement.
Provide required privacy notices and obtain required consents for Personal Data.
Protect the other Party's Confidential Information with reasonable care and limit disclosure to need-to-know personnel bound by confidentiality, for 2 years after the Agreement ends.
